title: Making File Names Unique
summary: Given an array of strings names of size n, create n folders such that at the i-th minute, a folder named names[i] is created.
statement: Given an array of strings names of size n, create n folders such that at the i-th minute, a folder named names[i] is created. If a name is repeated, append (k) where k is the smallest positive integer making the name unique. Return an array of the unique names assigned to each folder.
constraints: Process requested names in order; keep an unused name unchanged.
For a duplicate, append the smallest positive (k) suffix that makes it unused.
reference_solution:
def unique_folder_names(names):
 next_suffix={};answer=[]
 for name in names:
  if name not in next_suffix:answer.append(name);next_suffix[name]=1;continue
  suffix=next_suffix[name]
  while f'{name}({suffix})' in next_suffix:suffix+=1
  candidate=f'{name}({suffix})';answer.append(candidate);next_suffix[name]=suffix+1;next_suffix[candidate]=1
 return answer
